test_name: Happy Path - Full Auth Chain + Credit Limit Increase Flow + Success

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: Discovered Workflow: Happy Path - Full Auth Chain + Credit Limit Increase Flow + Success
proposed_scenarios.description: Tests the complete user journey from app launch, through login and OTP, handling popups, navigating to the credit limit increase feature, submitting a request, and verifying success.
proposed_scenarios.workflow_narrative: The user launches the application, bypasses the version check, logs in with valid credentials, completes the OTP verification, and dismisses initial popups. From the dashboard, they access the menu to initiate a credit limit increase. They select a specific demo credit card, enter a new requested limit, accept the agreement, review the details, and submit the request. Finally, they confirm the submission and return to the home screen.
appium_implementation_guidance: Use WebDriverWait for element presence and visibility, especially after app launch and screen transitions.
For OTP inputs, ensure the test framework can dynamically read the code from an environment variable.
Implement explicit waits for loading states, such as the dashboard list loading.
Verify text content and element visibility at key stages to confirm navigation and data accuracy.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify users can successfully complete the credit limit increase process from end-to-end.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As an existing customer, I want to increase my credit limit for a specific card so that I can have more purchasing power.

detailed_steps.description: Tap 'BACK TO HOME' to return to the dashboard.

expected_results: User successfully logs in and completes OTP verification.
Credit limit increase request is successfully submitted.
User is returned to the dashboard home screen.
edge_cases_to_test: Attempting to request a limit lower than current
data_requirements: Valid OTP code (dynamic via environment variable)
Existing demo credit card with mask '**** 1234'
prerequisites: Device connected and Appium server running.
